config.title: Session Timeout Hook

intro.title: Session Timeout Hook
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable Angular service that tracks user inactivity and triggers a session timeout warning. You will learn how to use RxJS Observables and Angular's dependency injection to create a custom hook-like service. The core concept involves listening to browser events to detect inactivity and managing state with timers. By the end, you'll have a practical service that can be integrated into any Angular component to enhance user experience with session management.
intro.usecase: Session timeout hooks are essential in security-sensitive applications like banking dashboards and healthcare portals where user sessions must automatically expire after inactivity. When users step away from medical record systems or financial trading platforms, these hooks trigger warnings and eventually log them out to prevent unauthorized access. Developers implement this pattern in admin panels, e-commerce checkout flows, and collaborative tools to balance security with user experience by giving clear countdown notifications before session termination.

objectives: Implement a custom Angular hook to track user inactivity
Configure inactivity timeout thresholds using reactive patterns
Initialize and manage session timeout state with RxJS observables
Integrate the session timeout hook into an Angular component
Bind user interaction events to reset the inactivity timer
Control session expiration behavior through configurable parameters
Render visual feedback when the session approaches timeout
